subject: Buy-flow lanes and integration readout: procurement & invoice routing
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@spectrumhealth.com>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@spectrumhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Buy-flow lanes and integration readout: procurement & invoice routing

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we all have the same page. Main objectives from the call: confirm economic decision-maker, identify procurement approvals, and align on PO/invoice routing + expected kick-off timeline for the pilot.

Recap (high level):
- Use case: pilot Redwood Inference for 3 services (hosted API + dedicated capacity for a 6-week PoC).
- Decision criteria: latency SLA, cost per 1M tokens, data isolation for PHI subset, and SOC 2 evidence.
- Primary contacts: Elena (procurement lead) and Michael (cloud/ops integration).

Open items we need to close:
1) Who will approve the PO (name/title) and any required approval threshold?
2) Is the Procurement mailbox the canonical ingest for PO? If not, share the intake URL/process and preferred PO format.
3) Any special invoicing instructions (bill-to entity, remit address, tax ID)?
4) Security evidence owner and whether a completed security questionnaire suffices or if SSO & KMS integration review is required pre-signed SOW.

Attachments: attached a first-pass SOW (redwood-sow-v1.pdf) and a sample PO template that mirrors what Finance typically needs.

Next steps / asks:
- Elena: please confirm the PO approver and whether procurement@ is preferred for PO intake by Tuesday EOD.
- Michael: can you confirm any network/ingress requirements we should include in the SOW?
- Jonas & Laura: see the attached SOW and flag any clauses that procurement will likely redline (Jonas for billing terms; Laura for data/KMS language).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan once we have the approver and intake path.

—
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0136
From: Michael Chu <michael.chu@spectrumhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <e.torres@spectrumhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@spectrumhealth.org, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buy-flow lanes and integration readout: procurement & invoice routing

Thanks Monica — quick clarifications from the technical side.

- PO intake: procurement@ is our standard but for pilots we sometimes route to a PO portal. Elena, we should confirm which lane applies.
- Approver: finance sign-off needed above $25k; for pilots < $25k our CIO approval suffices. I believe the economics for the initial PoC will be ~ $12–15k, so likely CIO sign-off. Elena, can you confirm?
- Network: we prefer outbound HTTPS egress to allowed endpoints only; if Redwood needs to initiate connections into our VPC we'll need a JIRA ticket and an approved network diagram.

Also copying in procurement for PO template requirements. For the SOW, please include an itemized recurring vs one-time costs (we need clarity for our chargeback system).

-Michael
Senior Cloud Engineer, Spectrum Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Buy-flow lanes and integration readout: procurement & invoice routing

Forwarding with internal notes for procurement readiness.

Internal notes:
- Billing: if the initial contract is below $25k, set billing frequency to a single invoice at pilot completion to simplify approvals. If Spectrum insists on milestone billing, ensure the SOW defines the milestone acceptance criteria.
- PO template: attached is a Redwood copy of a PO template we can pre-fill. procurement@spectrumhealth.org typically requires: bill-to name, remit address, PO number, tax ID, and a contact for invoice queries.

Attachment stub: spectrum-po-template.xlsx (pre-fill fields highlighted in yellow).

Laura — please review section 6 (Data & Security) in the attached SOW for KMS/SSO wording. Rishi — once Laura flags, I can prepare a minimal concession list for negotiation.

-Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@spectrumhealth.com>, procurement@spectrumhealth.org
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@spectrumhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buy-flow lanes and integration readout: procurement & invoice routing

Elena — appreciate the quick clarification. Confirming next steps on our side so procurement has everything to process a PO if you’re ready: 

Action list (owner / due):
- Elena (Procurement): confirm approver name/title and whether procurement@ or portal is preferred for PO ingest — due Thu, Apr 15 COB.
- Michael (Cloud): share any required network diagram or JIRA template if we need inbound connectivity — due Mon, Apr 19.
- Laura (Legal): redline SOW section 6 for KMS/SSO/data residency implications and return summary — due Wed, Apr 14.
- Jonas (RevOps): prepare a billing-friendly SOW version (single invoice option + milestone language) and a pre-filled PO sample — due Wed, Apr 14.
- Monica (me): prepare DocuSign SOW link once legal sign-off is received and send mutual action plan.

We will hold SOW signature until we have the approver and intake lane confirmed — keeps procurement from having to re-route. Attached again: redwood-sow-v1.pdf and the pre-fill PO template.

If it helps, we can also do a 20‑minute procurement-specific call with your team and ours to walk the PO fields and billing cadence. Happy to schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
